summary: Iteration 79: verified all 8 requested items plus the iteration-78 regressions. Backend pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_iter79.py: 16/18 passed (2 intentional failures documenting a backend RBAC parity gap). PDF exports verified by extracting text with pypdf (UK dates, Done column, tick/cross, speaker labels with timestamped transcripts injected temporarily then restored). Frontend verified via Playwright with cookie-injected admin/manager sessions: delete-meeting button + org-rename pencil are admin-only, add/remove action from a risk updates instantly and persists. Audit trail now records pdf_exported and transcript_exported (verified via API and in the UI Audit Trail tab). Iteration-78 regressions (EvidenceTab optimistic toggle, auth rate limiting) re-ran green (10/10).

minor.issue: RBAC parity gap: role check still allows 'manager' although the UI pencil is now admin-only. A manager can rename the organisation via direct API call (returned 200). Tighten to admin (+super_admin) to match intent.
RBAC parity gap: role check still allows 'manager' although Dashboard delete button is now admin-only. Manager delete returned 200 (meeting was actually deleted). Tighten to admin only.
Header meta line still prints ISO-ish date: 'Date: 2026-08-19 · Manager: Demo Manager'. Main report meta table is correctly DD/MM/YYYY; standalone transcript PDF was not converted to the UK format.

Safeguarding regex replacement is case-insensitive but the replacement is capitalised, so mid-sentence prose is broken: 'a potential safeguarding concern was noted' -> 'a Potential safeguarding was noted' (also drops the noun). Fine for the '[prefix] — description' risk template, risky for free prose (summary/insight fields). Consider anchoring the pattern to line/field start.

Cosmetic: export events set detail == label, so the UI renders 'Report PDF exported' twice (title + quoted detail). Suggest omitting detail or using something informative (e.g. 'includes transcript: yes/no').
STILL OPEN from iteration 78: prewarm call in AuthContext.js:113 is not role-gated, causing a 403 console error on dashboard load for attendee users.

issues: STILL OPEN from iteration 78: footer reads '1two.one © 2025' (Login.js:96,193; ResetPassword.js:91) while the in-app footer reads '© 2026 Supervision2'.

Observation (pre-existing test data, not a new regression): section is titled 'Anonymised' but for meeting 0f38f385 the transcript still contains raw PII (full names, phone number, street address) because the meeting was never anonymised. Consider suppressing the '(Anonymised)' wording when no anonymisation has run.

Make the safeguarding regex safe for mid-sentence prose (anchor or keep a noun) to avoid 'a Potential safeguarding was noted'.
Optional cleanups (carried over from iter78): role-gate the admin/users prewarm call, mask email on MFA screen, fix '© 2025' on Login/ResetPassword footers.
Optional: stop duplicating the audit label in the detail field for export events.
